blocker.description: No approved D3 Cohort B manifest exists, and no complete owner-approved 4-JPEG + 4-PNG source set exists. The known child-safety N01-N08 set is a separate synthetic PNG dataset and does not satisfy the photographic Cohort B contract (all-PNG, not owner-reviewed as Cohort B candidates). It, the v3q synthetic shape fixtures, D2 test fixtures, and unrelated local downloads were excluded; no image was executed, converted, cropped, regenerated, renamed, or substituted.
unblock_requirements: Provide exactly 4 files with .jpg or .jpeg extension and matching JPEG MIME, plus exactly 4 files with .png extension and matching PNG MIME.
Owner visually reviews all 8 actual images against the D3 exclusion list before hashing or execution.
Create a local git-ignored manifest with owner_reviewed=true, exact IDs, hashes, formats, dimensions, and byte counts.
Record an explicit Cohort B approval addendum in TASK_APPROVAL.md before execution.
